user.title: Quick Setup (Heat Pump & Electricity Price)
user.description: Connect your Heat Pump and Electricity Spot Price sensor. If you use Mitsubishi WF-RAC, indoor room temperature, outdoor temperature, and energy consumption are detected automatically!

data.price_sensor: Electricity Spot Price Sensor (e.g. Nordpool SE3, Tibber)
data.configure_advanced: Customize Advanced Options (Boiler, Solar, Battery, Custom Tariffs)

advanced_heat_pump.title: Advanced Heat Pump & Boiler Setup
advanced_heat_pump.description: Optional overrides for heat pump ratings and domestic hot water (DHW) boiler scheduling. If you use Mitsubishi WF-RAC, you can leave the sensor overrides empty.

data.boiler_entity: Water Heater / Boiler Switch or Entity (Optional)
data.boiler_run_hours_per_day: Water Heater Target Daily Heating Hours (h)

tariff.title: Electricity Tariff & Göteborg Energi Fees
tariff.description: Pre-configured with official Göteborg Energi Tidstariff (Winter High/Low Load) and Swedish energy taxes. Modify only if your contract differs.

data.grid_fee_high_load: Transmission Fee - High Load / Höglast (Winter weekdays 06-22)
data.spot_price_includes_vat: Spot Price Sensor Already Includes VAT

subsystems.title: Subsystems & Extensibility
subsystems.description: Select individual big consumers and optional solar, battery, and EV charger assets.
